summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **GIFT-SW** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)），并引入 Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), Injected Fine Tuning of Salient Weights (GIFT-SW) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：Based on this observation, we introduce a novel PEFT method, called Gaussian noise Injected Fine Tuning of Salient Weights (GIFT-SW)。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用底层算子融合、量化压缩与执行流加速。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Based on this observation, we introduce a novel PEFT method, called Gaussian noise Injected Fine Tuning of Salient Weights (GIFT-SW)。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments with LLaMA models demonstrate that GIFT-SW outperforms full fine-tuning and modern PEFT methods under the same computational budget）。
